messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Error with detectionHistory
parts:
Hi,

the error message says your records are before camera setup. For example SDC01, setup was 29 April 2018. The function found records at that station e.g. on 7 March 2018 (and some other days).

Now if you say those dates are not the correct dates of the records, it suggests that argument recordDateTime is set wrongly. Indeed, it is: "%Y-%M-%d", so it is specified as not having hour / minute / second infomation. I suspect that is not correct.

I don't know what the format of your DateTimeOriginal column is, but the default is "ymd HMS" (note that you can use lubridate syntax here as well, easier than "%Y-%M..."). If there are no seconds (because Excel removed them), it's "ymd HM".

If in doubt feel free to share how your DateTimeOriginal column is formatted.

Best regards,

Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Error with detectionHistory
parts:
Hi Aina,
yes, Excel sometimes does that. But deleting not just seconds, but also hours and minutes , that is quite surprising. Thank you for sharing your experience. 
It is also the reason why recordTable() returns date and time as separate column, and not only the DateTimeOriginal column. It may seem redundant, but allows recombining them in case Excel messes up DateTimeOriginal.
Best regards, 
Jürgen
